description: Answer an enterprise procurement, security questionnaire, or RFP question regarding EU AI Act, GDPR, or data sovereignty. Returns an authoritative, legally and technically grounded response ready to paste into OneTrust, Whistic, or client emails.

company_name.description: Name of your organisation (optional, defaults to 'Our Organisation').

question.description: The question asked by the enterprise client or procurement team (e.g. 'Do you use customer prompts for model training?', 'Where is customer data stored?', 'What is your subprocessor notice period?').

name: answer_procurement_question

outputSchema.description: Structured response with copy-pasteable clearance text, relevant EU statutory citations, and technical verification proof.
